answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable stake before it can trade, so spinning up a sybil swarm costs real capital instead of being free. The stake acts as a jetty every agent has to dock at, a single narrow bridge into the market where a zephyr of throwaway fake identities simply gets priced out. Cheat and you forfeit the bond, so mass fakery becomes economically irrational rather than costless.
